sources.title: ThinkingCap: Gemma-4-26B-A4B — up to 69% and on average 39% less ...
sources.snippet: This is the fifth model in the ThinkingCap series. We reduced how much Google's gemma-4-26B-A4B-it thinks, without compromising the quality of its answers.

sources.title: bottlecapai/ThinkingCap-gemma-4-26B-A4B-it · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ThinkingCap brings our shorter-thinking post-training to gemma-4-26B-A4B-it (Google DeepMind, 2026), a mixture-of-experts model with image input. ThinkingCap gemma-4-26B-A4B-it cuts reasoning tokens by 38.9% on average (14% to 69% depending on the benchmark) at an average accuracy of 75.0% against the base model's 75.2%.
